default.description: Core permissions for the three webviews CodexBar ships: the tray popover (`popover`), the settings window (`settings`) and the floating desktop widget (`widget`, created on demand by `widget.rs`; it listens to the same `usage-updated` event, so it needs `core:event:default` too). Only core plugin commands need a capability — Tauri 2 allows every command registered through the app's `invoke_handler` (get_report, refresh_now, get_settings, set_settings, settings_info, default_settings, session_states, reauth_*, open_settings, hide_settings, hide_popover, quit, …) by default. `core:event:default` is what the popover was missing: without it `plugin:event|listen` was rejected by the ACL and the UI never received the `usage-updated` event pushed by the background refresh tick.
